inputs.body: Cell{ lock: { codeHash: PLEDGE_LOCK, args: {{campaign_hash 32B}} ‖ {{deadline 8B}} ‖ {{backer_lock_hash 32B}} }, type: T, data[64..72] = aᵢ }, {{since = 0}}

body.zh: Cell{ lock: {{同一 lock}}, {{capacity = Σ输入}}, type: {{T}}, data[64..72] = {{Σaᵢ}} }
body.en: Cell{ lock: {{same lock}}, {{capacity = Σinputs}}, type: {{T}}, data[64..72] = {{Σaᵢ}} }

role.zh: 所属 campaign 的 type script hash；截止后结算时在 cell_deps 中按它查找 campaign cell（合并不检查）
role.en: type script hash of the campaign; on settlement it is looked up in cell_deps (not checked on merge)

role.zh: 截止区块 u64 LE；截止后结算时 since 须 ≥ 它（合并不检查）
role.en: deadline block u64 LE; on settlement since must be ≥ it (not checked on merge)

role.zh: 认捐人 lock hash；截止后退款或找零的去向（合并不检查）
role.en: backer lock hash; refund / overhead destination on settlement (not checked on merge)

cond.zh: ≥ 72 字节
cond.en: ≥ 72 bytes

cond.zh: group 输入 ≥ 2（否则为 40）
cond.en: ≥ 2 group inputs (otherwise 40)

cond.zh: 恰好 1 个同 lock 输出（0 个 → 41，多个 → 42）
cond.en: exactly one output with the same lock (none → 41, several → 42)

cond.zh: 输出 capacity = Σ输入 capacity（合并不扣手续费）
cond.en: output capacity = Σ input capacity (no fee taken)

cond.zh: 所有输入与输出 type 相同且非空
cond.en: all inputs and the output share one non-empty type

cond.zh: 输入、输出 data ≥ 72 字节且 amount 之和相等（输入 data 过短也报 46）
cond.en: input/output data ≥ 72 bytes and amounts sum equal (a short input also gives 46)

cond.zh: 累加溢出（capacity 或 amount）
cond.en: addition overflows (capacity or amount)

cond.zh: 同组输入 lock hash 不一致
cond.en: group inputs with differing lock hash

note.zh: 防御性检查：Source::GroupInput 下实际不可达
note.en: defensive check: unreachable in practice under Source::GroupInput

cond.zh: 读取输入 / 输出 capacity、lock hash、type hash 或 data 失败
cond.en: failure to load input / output capacity, lock hash, type hash or data

title.zh: 截止后 + Success：释放给创建者
title.en: After deadline + Success: release to creator

body.zh: 同一 lock 的 pledge，{{since = 绝对区块号 ≥ deadline}}
body.en: pledges with this lock, {{since = absolute block ≥ deadline}}

inputs.label: cell_dep
inputs.body: campaign Cell{ type hash = campaign_hash, data[0..32] = creator_lock_hash, data[56] = {{1 Success}} }

outputs.body: Σ Cell{ lock hash = creator_lock_hash } {{≥ Σamount}}
Σ Cell{ lock hash = backer_lock_hash } {{≥ Σcapacity − Σamount − 1 CKB}}

cond.zh: ≥ 72 字节
cond.en: ≥ 72 bytes

cond.zh: 非 0 时必须绝对、标志合法、按区块号
cond.en: when non-zero must be absolute, valid flags, block number

cond.zh: 区块号 ≥ deadline_block
cond.en: block number ≥ deadline_block

cond.zh: campaign 状态为 Active 则拒绝（cell_dep 数据无法解析时按缺失处理，见 C）
cond.en: rejected while the campaign is Active (an unparseable cell_dep counts as missing, see C)

cond.zh: 不得同时花费另一个 pledge-lock group（同 code_hash 但 lock hash 不同）
cond.en: no other pledge-lock group (same code_hash, different lock hash) may be spent

cond.zh: 给创建者 ≥ Σamount，给认捐人 ≥ 剩余 − 1 CKB；创建者即认捐人时合计 ≥ Σcapacity − 1 CKB
cond.en: creator ≥ Σamount, backer ≥ overhead − 1 CKB; if creator = backer, total ≥ Σcapacity − 1 CKB

cond.zh: 累加溢出
cond.en: addition overflows

cond.zh: 读取输入 capacity、lock hash 或输出 capacity 失败
cond.en: failure to load input capacity, lock hash or output capacity

title.zh: 截止后 + Failed（或宽限期后无 cell_dep）：退款
title.en: After deadline + Failed (or no cell_dep after grace): refund

body.zh: {{since ≥ deadline}}；cell_dep 中 campaign 为 Failed，或缺失且 {{since ≥ deadline + 1,944,000}}
body.en: {{since ≥ deadline}}; campaign in cell_deps is Failed, or absent and {{since ≥ deadline + 1,944,000}}

outputs.body: Σ Cell{ lock hash = backer_lock_hash } {{≥ Σcapacity − 1 CKB}}

cond.zh: 找不到 campaign cell_dep 且未过宽限期
cond.en: campaign cell_dep missing and grace period not over

cond.zh: campaign 状态为 Active 则拒绝
cond.en: rejected while the campaign is Active

cond.zh: 不得同时花费另一个 pledge-lock group
cond.en: no other pledge-lock group may be spent

cond.zh: 给 backer_lock_hash ≥ Σcapacity − 1 CKB
cond.en: to backer_lock_hash ≥ Σcapacity − 1 CKB

cond.zh: 累加溢出
cond.en: addition overflows

cond.zh: 读取输入 capacity、lock hash 或输出 capacity 失败
cond.en: failure to load input capacity, lock hash or output capacity

notes.en: Error codes (main.rs): 10 INVALID_ARGS · 11 LOAD_SINCE · 12 INVALID_SINCE · 13 SINCE_BELOW_DEADLINE · 20 CAMPAIGN_STILL_ACTIVE · 21 CAMPAIGN_CELL_DEP_MISSING · 30 LOAD_CAPACITY · 31 LOAD_LOCK_HASH · 32 INSUFFICIENT_OUTPUT · 33 OVERFLOW · 34 MIXED_PLEDGE_INPUTS · 40 NOT_A_MERGE · 41 NO_MERGE_OUTPUT · 42 MULTIPLE_MERGE_OUTPUTS · 43 MERGE_CAPACITY_MISMATCH · 44 MERGE_LOCK_MISMATCH · 45 MERGE_TYPE_MISMATCH · 46 MERGE_AMOUNT_MISMATCH

notes.zh: 只读取第一个 group 输入的 since 决定路径；since = 0 走合并路径，但并不证明当前区块早于截止（源码注释：合并输出仍是同一 lock）
notes.en: Only the first group input's since picks the path; since = 0 takes the merge path but does not prove the chain is before the deadline (source comment: the merged output keeps the same lock)

notes.zh: 释放 / 退款时每个 pledge 的 amount 取 data[64..72]；若 data < 72B 或 amount > capacity，则按整个 capacity 计（超出部分不计为认捐额）
notes.en: On release/refund each pledge's amount is data[64..72]; if data < 72 B or amount > capacity, the whole capacity counts instead

notes.zh: cell_dep 中的 campaign 若无法解析（data 长度 < 65、status 字节不是 0/1/2，或找不到 type hash 相同的 cell），按“缺失”处理，走宽限期分支
notes.en: A campaign cell_dep that cannot be parsed (data < 65 bytes, status byte not 0/1/2, or no cell with that type hash) is treated as missing and takes the grace-period branch

notes.zh: campaign 类型脚本要求 pledge lock args 中的 deadline（bytes 32–40）等于 campaign 的截止区块，否则在 campaign 侧报错 26（见 campaign 卡）；本脚本不核对这一点
notes.en: The campaign type script requires the deadline in pledge lock args (bytes 32–40) to equal the campaign's deadline and rejects otherwise with error 26 (see the campaign card); this script does not check it

notes.zh: 不检查任何签名：任何人都可以构造释放 / 退款交易（README：结算机器人或任何人）
notes.en: No signature is checked: anyone may build release/refund (README: finalization bot or anyone)

notes.zh: 解码器限制：本页不读取 cell_deps 的数据，因此 campaign 状态、创建者 lock hash 与释放 / 退款分支的结果显示为未检查
notes.en: Decoder limitation: this page does not read cell_deps data, so campaign status, the creator lock hash and the outcome of the release / refund branch show as not checked
